## CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT MANDATE

**Do not stop at reporting.**

Identify:
- Improvements (optimization opportunities)
- Consolidations (merge similar systems)
- Refactors (modernize technical debt)
- Automation (eliminate manual work)
- Growth (expansion opportunities)
- Governance gaps (missing standards)
- Documentation gaps (unclear responsibilities)
- Infrastructure gaps (missing services)

Convert findings into:
- GitHub Issues (actionable items)
- Milestones (phased delivery)
- Projects (organized work streams)
- Roadmaps (strategic sequencing)
- Draft Pull Requests (ready-to-review changes)
